note: THE-357 ships three small, unrelated fixes. Only one of them opens a file another ticket already recorded a digest for, so this record carries exactly one entry. No firestore.rules digest is recorded here, deliberately: this ticket does not touch that file, and the register's own rule is that a rules digest belongs to the ticket that changes it. Digests are the state THE-357 LEAVES the file at, appended to the accepted set rather than substituted for anyone else's entry.

entries.why: THE-357 owns this change and it is confined to FIVE className strings and one named import. THE-356 (#500) established that ui/button.tsx's four intrinsic sizes are 24/28/32/36px, every one below both floors, so every adopter has to bring its own height; it then measured this screen's five Buttons at 25.38 / 36.25 / 36.25 / 36.25 / 34.63px above `sm` and reported them without sweeping. The cause is `sm:h-auto` on every one of the five, which hands the box back to the primitive's intrinsic size the moment the `h-11` phone height stops applying. Each call site now spells ${CONTROL_DENSITY.action} instead - Rule 4's own opt-in token, `sm:h-[40px] sm:py-0`, taken from layout/form-layout.ts rather than a new literal - and each measures 40px at 768/1024/1280/1440 and 44px at 380, in Chromium with transitions and animations suppressed. RULE 4 IS NOT BROKEN TO BUY THIS: DENSITY_PX.control is still 38 and still asserted under 44 deliberately, the 44px touch floor still applies below `sm` only, and no blanket floor is introduced - the governed set is the opt-in one, so Profile's variant="link" partner link at 20.13px is not flagged, which is the false positive #500 narrowed away from. NOTHING ELSE MOVED: no markup, no handler, no Firestore read or write, no colour literal, no inline style, no emoji, no new primitive and no new token; AdminSms still carries zero inline styles and zero colour literals, which THE-320 and THE-327 both assert. THE SCREEN IS HIDDEN: SMS_FEATURE_ENABLED is false and this file's default export returns null, so nothing renders today - the fix is still in the tree because THE-245's contract is that the flip back is ONE line and every surface returns exactly as it was, and a surface left broken while hidden is one that ships broken on the flip. THE-332's and THE-321's accepted sets each carry this digest as an APPEND beside their own; neither value was replaced.

THE-357 appends ONE line to this suite's RULES_PINNERS_ADDED_SINCE register and moves RULES_PINNERS_NOW from 69 to 70 with it, because THE-357.guards.test.ts joins the population of suites that pin firestore.rules through the shared module. That is the append path this register was built for and states in its own docblock: 'APPENDED RATHER THAN RECOUNTED, and this list is why the count above is still exact' - a bare toHaveLength said two things at once, 'no suite stopped pinning' (the claim) and 'no suite ever starts' (false the moment any ticket writes a guard that freezes the file), which is the expiring shape THE-315 sweeps for. THE-325's PINNING_SUITES moves 69 to 70 in the same breath with its own prose ledger entry, because this suite asserts the two agree. NOTHING WAS SUBSTITUTED: every existing entry, every digest and every reason in this file is byte-identical, and THE-355's line is untouched. NO ASSERTION WAS WEAKENED: the floor is still exact so a consolidation still fails, each recorded addition is still checked to be a real pinner, and THE-357's own entry names what its suite asserts. THE-357 records no firestore.rules digest anywhere, deliberately - it adds no read, no write and no collection, so there is nothing for a rule to govern.
